def load_team_membership_csv(course, response):
    """
    Load a CSV detailing course membership.

    Arguments:
        course (CourseDescriptor): Course module for which CSV
            download has been requested.
        response (HttpResponse): Django response object to which
            the CSV content will be written.
    """
    # Implementation of CSV loading logic goes here
    import csv
    from io import StringIO

    output = StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(output)
    writer.writerow(['Member ID', 'Member Name'])  # Example header

    # Here you would typically loop through course members and write their details
    for member in course.get_members():  # Assuming get_members() returns a list of members
        writer.writerow([member.id, member.name])  # Example member data

    response.write(output.getvalue())
